digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate — dependency scoping and attestation
propositions: Container tickets with no declared file_impact fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation, causing re-review on every unrelated commit and creating gate-economics drag in parallel epic/child workflows

When a container's non-closed direct children all declare non-empty file_impact, the container's signed dependency set should inherit the union of own file_impact, review citations, and children's declared scopes

If any non-closed direct child has empty file_impact, inheritance must be poisoned and the container must preserve its pre-change dependency set (empty→whole-HEAD fallback) to maintain fail-closed semantics
Closed children must neither contribute files to the inherited union nor poison inheritance, since their work is delivered and subject to ADR 0024's completion floor
Direct-child file_impact edits must invalidate the container's attestation via material_fingerprint pin drift, ensuring inheritance cannot go silently stale one level deep
